## What this changes

## Type

- [ ] New/changed **rule** (cite the class and ID; new rules land as `Proposed`)
- [ ] New/changed **class**
- [ ] **Spec** (verifies a product/architecture against a class)
- [ ] **Pattern** (architectural blueprint)
- [ ] **Platform profile** (version-pinned, cited)
- [ ] **Docs / guide / other**

## Checklist

- [ ] Follows the format of existing files (rule tables, spec/profile headers, etc.)
- [ ] Rules/claims are **verifiable** and any non-obvious fact **cites a source**
- [ ] Unverified facts are labeled as such; material corrections are **shown, not silently edited** (for profiles/specs)
- [ ] Rule IDs referenced are correct and stable (IDs are permanent — see [GOVERNANCE](../GOVERNANCE.md#identifier-stability))
- [ ] Relative links resolve
- [ ] Commits are signed off (`git commit -s`) per the [DCO](../CONTRIBUTING.md#licensing--provenance)
